title: From ‘killing the golden goose’ to better than ever: Has Alberta's relationship with Ottawa changed?
description: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith once said Ottawa "couldn't help" but be fixated on "punishing" the energy sector. Now, she says Canada is working better than it ever has. So what changed? And will it stick?
text: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith once said Ottawa "couldn't help" but be fixated on "punishing" the energy sector. The relationship between Alberta and the federal government has faced its share of political and economic conflict over the years.
speech_text:
From ‘killing the golden goose’ to better than ever: Has Alberta's relationship with Ottawa changed?

Alberta Premier Danielle Smith once said Ottawa "couldn't help" but be fixated on "punishing" the energy sector. The relationship between Alberta and the federal government has faced its share of political and economic conflict over the years.
